views.front: A long spacebar and separated modifier keys make the keyboard layout clearer, and the mouse has a shaped shell with visible controls.
views.rear: The reverse view preserves the keyboard footprint and the mouse's rounded palm shape.
views.detail: Full-size detail confirms the real long spacebar and distinct lower-row modifiers; blank key legends remain an explicit catalog-scale simplification.
views.underside: Both devices retain closed supported undersides and their original relative placement.
views.clay: The clay view confirms differentiated key widths and the smooth mouse shell without changing the original device envelopes.
